label: Title
description:
Primary Title - Main title used to identify and display the asset, e.g., Portrait of a Young Woman
Alternate Title - Alternative or variant title, e.g., Young Woman Portrait
Determination - Used for taxon records where title does not apply
displaySpec:
1 - Title displays as it is in source system(CMS)
2 - This is mandatory data; CCS cannot display a record without a title

label: Object Type
description: Broad type of collection asset represented by the record
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

2 - If 'date collected' is available, CCS will display as-is
3 - Only when year is available, the system will add month and year for search purposes

label: Creator
encompasses:
Primary Creator; Primary Creator Role; Secondary Creator; Secondary Creator Role; Party Name; Party Type; Date of Birth; Date of Death; organisation name

Skin Name; Language; Clan; Artist Location; Country; Father's Country; Grandmother's Country; Moiety; Mother's Country; Region; Totem;
description: Person or organisation responsible for creating the asset, e.g., John Longstaff
displaySpec:
1 - Creator can be person or organisation (which is association)
2 - Values displayed in CCS will be as per the source system - display value
3 - For person, the values displayed would be in this order - "Full name (Dob - DoD) [nationality] role"
4 - For organisation, the values displayed would be in this order - "organisation name (estab. DoB, closed. DoD)"
5 - If any of the values are not available, then CCS will just not display the data
examples:
Rupert Bunny (b. 29 September 1864 - d. 25 May 1947) [Australian] Artist

Harringtons Metallurigists Pty Ltd (closed 2002)

Rupert Bunny (b. 29 September 1864 - d. 25 May 1947) [Australian]
For person, when the DoB is not available - 
Rupert Bunny (d. 25 May 1947) [Australian]
For person, when DoD is not available - 
Rupert Bunny (d. 25 May 1947) [Australian]

label: Measurements (previosly mentioned as Dimensions)
encompasses: Measures - Height, width, depth, diameter, weights, units, display value and extent (Eg; archives)
description: Physical or technical measurements
displaySpec:
1 - The information displayed on CCS will depend on the data available in source system
2 - CCS label will be 'Measurements'
3 - The value displayed will be whats available from source system.
4 - Any available data needs to be displayed with the units (Units of measure)
5 - The value displayed will have the details of the object along with the dimensions
6 - The information will be displayed as per the 'display value' when available (Example is MDHS)

Vase 180 cm
When weight is not available - 
Vase 180 x 30 x 100 cm 
Extent - 2 boxes

label: Inscription
description: Inscription, signature, label or other text recorded on the asset
displaySpec:
1 - Multiple inscriptions should be displayed by inscription type:
2 - Each Inscription type will be identified by 'inscription type' and list of inscriptions separated by comma
3 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
examples:
Signatures; signature 1, signature 2
Inscriptions: inscription 1, inscription 2
questions:

label: Language
description: Language of the asset or its content, e.g., English
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Subject
description: Topic, theme or concept represented by the asset, e.g., Military history
displaySpec:
1 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
2 - It is preferred that these classifications work as a hyperlink - Clicking on this link will enable the user to search for records with the selected classification.

label: Description
description: Descriptive or interpretive text about the asset
displaySpec: To display just the brief intro text (2-3 lines) - Need ux input

label: Classification
description: Classification within a defined scheme, e.g., Furniture or Eucalyptus globulus
displaySpec:
1 - Primary and Secondary classification, when available, will be in a string (one line of text).
2 - Primary and Secondary Classification will be hyphenated to distinguish.
3 - It is preferred that these classifications work as a hyperlink - Clicking on this link will enable the user to search for records with the selected classification.
4 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
5 - The user will not be informed if the value presented here is primary or secondary classification

label: Source URL
description: Link to the asset in an existing or legacy collection browser.
displaySpec:
1 - The availability of the external systems (browsers) is out of scope for CCS (broken urls, websites are down etc)
2 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
examples:
Examples of inconsistency and unavailability of browsers:
1 - Malformed url supplied (e.g. htp:/example missing protocol, stray text)
2 - URL points to a broken/non-existent page (404)
3 - External site is unreachable/down

label: Access
description: Access conditions or restrictions, e.g., Open access, On display
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Related Record
displaySpec:
1 - When multiple values, CCS will list each value in separate lines
2 - Each line will be identified with a relation type (parent or child)
3 - There will always be one parent record but multiple child records
4 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
examples:
Parent - related record 1; 
Child - related record 3
questions:
